q1: SELECT NAME FROM SALESPERSON AS S WHERE 0 = ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ORDERS AS O JOIN COMPANY AS C ON O.COM_ID = C.COM_ID WHERE O.SALES_ID = S.SALES_ID AND C.NAME = 'RED' )
q2: WITH CTE AS ( SELECT DISTINCT S.SALES_ID FROM ORDERS O JOIN COMPANY C ON O.COM_ID = C.COM_ID JOIN SALESPERSON S ON O.SALES_ID = S.SALES_ID WHERE C.NAME = 'RED' ) SELECT SS.NAME FROM SALESPERSON SS WHERE SALES_ID NOT IN (SELECT A.SALES_ID FROM CTE A)
